title: Directs the Department of Justice to study possible modifications to post-conviction relief proceeding procedures to increase efficiency, and provide the results of the study to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly no later than December 31, 2026.

claims.text: SB 261 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
